about: Morinville is a town in Alberta’s Sturgeon County country just north of St. Albert and Edmonton, on Highway 2. A Francophone founding, the landmark St. Jean Baptiste church, and a growing Edmonton-region commuter role define the community. About 10,000 people live in Morinville.
seoSummary: Town north of St. Albert and Edmonton—Francophone roots, landmark church, and Highway 2 commuter community.
